item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.38)] History Says What the 2025 Auto Tariffs Cost General Motors, and Canada's Rate Is About to Double
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.38)
Former President Trump announced that tariffs on Canadian cars, trucks, auto parts, and steel will increase to 50% by January 1, 2027, with some tariffs already in effect and Canada planning retaliation. Despite concerns, General Motors' prior experience with 25% tariffs in 2025 showed that the actual cost was less than initially forecasted, with the company offsetting significant expenses and even raising profit guidance. GM has also been reducing its Canadian manufacturing footprint, suggesting that the new tariffs might have a greater impact on Japanese automakers with larger Canadian production.

item.description:
